Message.Name: Seconds Message
Message.Description: This message is sent every second for which at least one ASX ITCH message is being generated. The message contains the number of seconds since the start of 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC, also called Unix Time.

Field.Name: Second
Field.Description: Unix time (number of seconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC).

Message.Name: Order Book Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Order Book Directory messages are disseminated for all active instruments.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Denotes the primary identifier of an order book (instrument).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: The unique instrument series name (ins_id_s in ASX Trade).

Field.Name: Long Name
Field.Description: Additional instrument series information. May be blank and may not necessarily be unique across all series (long_ins_id_s in ASX Trade).

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN code identifying the instrument.

Field.Name: Financial Product
Field.Description: Financial Product value

Field.Name: Trading Currency
Field.Description: Trading currency

Field.Name: Number of decimals in Price
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals used in price for this order book.

Field.Name: Number of decimals in Nominal Value
Field.Description: This value defines the number of decimals used in the nominal value for this order book.

Field.Name: Odd Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represent an odd lot for the order book.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of shares that represent a round lot for the order book.

Field.Name: Block Lot Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of securities that represent a block lot for the order book.

Field.Name: Nominal Value
Field.Description: Nominal value

Field.Name: ISIN

Field.Name: Trading Currency

Message.Name: Tick Size Table Entry Message
Message.Description: This message contains information on a tick size for a price range. Together, all Tick Size messages with the same Order Book ID form a complete Tick Size Table. Each order book has a set of Tick Size Table Entries to define its tick size table.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: The order book this entry belongs to (instrument).

Field.Name: Tick Size
Field.Description: Tick Size for the given price range.

Field.Name: Price From
Field.Description: Start of price range for this entry.

Field.Name: Price To
Field.Description: End of price range for this entry.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Event code value

Message.Name: Order Book State Message
Message.Description: The Order Book State message relays information on session state changes.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order Book Identifier (instrument).

Field.Name: State Name
Field.Description: Name of the session state.

Message.Name: Add Order - No Participant ID Message
Message.Description: This message will be generated for anonymous instruments in ASX Trade

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the new order. Note that the number is only unique per order book and side.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order Book Identifier (instrument).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Order Book Position
Field.Description: Rank within the order book. See Building an Order Book View for details.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The visible quantity of the order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The price of the new order. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Exchange Order Type
Field.Description: Additional order attributes

Field.Name: Lot Type
Field.Description: Lot Type value

Message.Name: Add Order - Participant ID Message
Message.Description: This message will be generated for non-anonymous instruments in ASX Trade

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: The identifier assigned to the new order. Note that the number is only unique per order book and side.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order Book Identifier (instrument).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being added.

Field.Name: Order Book Position
Field.Description: Rank within the order book. See Building an Order Book View for details.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The visible quantity of the order.

Field.Name: Price

Field.Name: Exchange Order Type
Field.Description: Additional order attributes

Field.Name: Lot Type
Field.Description: Lot Type value

Field.Name: Participant ID
Field.Description: Participant identifier associated with the entered order

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order in the book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: The order ID associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order Book Identifier (instrument).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: The traded quantity.

Field.Name: Match ID
Field.Description: Assigned by the system to each match executed.

Field.Name: Participant ID, owner
Field.Description: Participant identifier of the owner of the order. Blank for anonymous instruments.

Field.Name: Participant ID, counterparty
Field.Description: Participant identifier of the counterparty to the execution. Blank for anonymous instruments.

Message.Name: Order Executed with Price Message
Message.Description: This message is sent when an order in the book is executed in whole or in part with a price different than the initial display price.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: The order ID associated with the executed order.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order Book Identifier (instrument).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being executed.

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: The traded quantity.

Field.Name: Match ID
Field.Description: Assigned by the system to each match executed.

Field.Name: Participant ID, owner
Field.Description: Participant identifier of the owner of the order. Blank for anonymous instruments.

Field.Name: Participant ID, counterparty
Field.Description: Participant identifier of the counterparty to the execution. Blank for anonymous instruments.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: The traded price.

Field.Name: Occurred at Cross
Field.Description: Indicates if an order was executed in an auction.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be included in trade tickers and volume calculations.

Message.Name: Order Replace Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order in the book has been replaced. The remaining quantity from the original order is no longer accessible and must be removed.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: The original order identifier of the order being replaced.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order Book identifier (instrument).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being replaced.

Field.Name: New Order Book Position
Field.Description: New rank within the order book.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The new visible quantity of the order. Orders with an undisclosed quantity will have this field set to 0.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The new price of the order.

Field.Name: Exchange Order Type
Field.Description: Additional order attributes.

Message.Name: Order Delete Message
Message.Description: This message is sent whenever an order in the book is deleted. There will be no remaining quantity, so the order should be removed from the book.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Order ID
Field.Description: The ID of the order being deleted.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order Book identifier (instrument).

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of order being deleted.

Message.Name: Trade Message
Message.Description: The Trade Message is designed to provide details for executions in dark order books and reporting the individual legs of traded combinations.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp.

Field.Name: Match ID
Field.Description: The unique reference number assigned to the order on the book being executed.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: The type of non-display order being matched.

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: The quantity being matched in this execution.

Field.Name: Order Book ID
Field.Description: Order Book identifier (instrument).

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: The price of the trade.

Field.Name: Participant ID, owner
Field.Description: Participant identifier of the owner of the order. Blank for anonymous instruments.

Field.Name: Participant ID, counterparty
Field.Description: Participant identifier of the counterparty to the execution. Blank for anonymous instruments.

Field.Name: Printable
Field.Description: Indicates if the execution should be included in trade tickers and volume calculations.

Field.Name: Occurred at Cross
Field.Description: Occurred at Cross value.
